title: Assembly story added for the executable wiring
description: ANALYSIS.md has no story that connects parsing, scanning, ordering, and rendering into the built executable. Without one, the command-line stories cannot be verified through the binary. A feature assembly story named pipeline owns cmd/dupfind/main.go and depends on the members that deliver the behavior.
system_choice: Keep the pipeline assembly story as the single owner of cmd/dupfind/main.go.

title: Feature criteria run native Go tests on internal packages
description: Scan and listing stories precede the executable and the command-line stories. Their criteria therefore run native Go tests on internal packages through run_test. Command-line criteria use cli_runner only after the pipeline story builds the executable.
system_choice: Scan and listing criteria use run_test on internal packages. Command-line and end-to-end criteria use cli_runner.

title: Argument parsing uses the standard flag package
description: TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md lists no command-line platform file, so no cli.md stack is selected. The standard library flag package is the conventional choice for a standard-library-only Go CLI.
system_choice: Parse arguments with flag.FlagSet and flag.ContinueOnError, per the Go layout guidance.
